```plato

//==
// # Roulettes (rolling-circle curves)
//
// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roulette_(curve).

// The path of a point on the rim of a circle of radius Radius rolling along
// the X axis: x = Radius * (theta - sin theta), y = Radius * (1 - cos theta),
// with the rolling angle theta swept over Angles
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cycloid).
type Cycloid2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    Radius: Number;
    Angles: AngleInterval;
}
```
